data_section_full_text:
We extract data from the intersection of CRSP and Compustat for the years 1962–2005. All data definitions are
presented in the appendix. We delete firm years with missing data for any of the variables used in estimation, and firm
years with negative total assets or book value of equity. Annual returns are obtained by cumulating monthly returns
starting from the fourth month after the firm’s fiscal year end (Hayn, 1995; Basu, 1997).

We delete firm years with price per share less than $1, and firms in the top and bottom 1% of earnings, returns, size,
market-to-book ratio, leverage and depreciation each year (e.g., Ball et al., 2000). These filters result in a sample of 115,516
